visual.name: reportingGantt
visual.description: Reporting Gantt — generic timeline visual for Power BI. Activity swim lanes with unlimited per-area color customization, chevron-style time axis, milestone markers with conditional labels and collision detection, activity health indicators with per-value icon binding, baseline-vs-actual glide-path tracking with variance escalation, drag-to-resize regions, persistent splitter and sort state, and a customizable filter sidebar supporting up to 256 dimensions. Data-driven with operator-bound per-row overrides, per-type symbol/size/color/visibility controls, accent theming, and structured tooltips.
